lines.en: I shift slowly over the ground.
My bulk trails behind me.
Two colours turn inside me.
Every move I make, I wobble.
I squeeze past that low tree.
My gel slides over the turf.

lines.zh: 我比普通史莱姆重多了。
lines.en: I am far heavier than an ordinary slime.
The two cores inside me rotate.
I flow around a patch of mushrooms.

lines.zh: 我身上的两种胶在打架。
lines.en: The two gels in me fight each other.
I flow around the stone.
I press shallow dents into the ground.
I remember both diets.
I press the grass into a path.
The grass I pass lies flat.

lines.zh: 我停下来喘，一个史莱姆也累。
lines.en: I stop to rest; even a slime tires.
I pulse quietly.
Both cores glow together.
I am one blob of two things.
My surface flows slowly.
I give off a little light.
This patch is peaceful enough.
I am deciding which to produce.
There are bubbles in my gel.
I am pressing down a patch of grass.
I do not think very much.
I am waiting to be fed.
The wind cannot push this gel.
Both my cores turn toward you.
I lean to one side.
There are two cores inside me.
Are you here to feed me?
I bulge up slowly.
I do not chase people.
Do not feed me anything more.
I wobble and stay.
When I speak, it comes out as a gurgle.
I am heavy and do not go far.
A lump got knocked off me.
I gather myself back bit by bit.
Gel splatters everywhere.
I do not feel much pain.
I swell, then sag.
Both cores wobbled.
I retreat a short way.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的颜色乱了。
lines.en: That upset my colours.
I ease away to one side.
Do not touch my two cores.
Which Plort is that?
A third kind would cause trouble.
Both cores are stirring.
That smell makes me want to grow.
I move closer, slowly.
Do not pour it all in one spot.
I swallow, and I swell a little.
A second kind is all I can hold.
Mixing more would go badly.
Hold your hand steady.
My whole mass presses in.
The gel pushes you aside.
I bounce and cling back.
A coat of gel is on you.
It does not hurt; I only deform.
I slowly round out again.
The gel hits with a sticky thud.
The ground sinks under me.
I draw back one lump of gel.
That is not a fight.
I brush past your leg.
My whole mass crowds you.
I slide to your feet.
I have you half surrounded.
Both cores want to split off.
A third kind would ruin us.
I press over inch by inch.
We merge and part again.
Do not let a third kind in.
That patch is wide enough for both of us.
Our gel recognises itself.
This time it will not go wrong.
We part, and each produces its own.
Do not rush it.
I have wrapped it up.
It has sunk into the gel.
I push it back out. Not food.
This thing prickles.
It lodges between my two cores.
The stuff on the ground, I wrap up.
It turns inside me.
I swelled a little.
I wrap it up and consider it.
I dissolve it bit by bit.
Something living came in range.
I turn toward it in slow layers.
Both cores are moving at once.
My whole mass bears in.
My gel is gathering.
My mass starts to tip forward.
I am about to shove.
Slow, but very heavy.
This is where it starts.
Both my cores have set the same direction.
I keep oozing your way.
You back off and I take it.
I leave a long wet trail.
The gap between us is tightening.
My gel is swelling.
The corner has you.
I am not fast, but I am sticky.
One lump closer.
I slowly envelop.
Nearly pressed on you.
My whole mass slams down.
The gel pins you.
I push you backward.
When you pull, the gel holds.
This lump lands solid.
Both halves of my gel press down.
I press down on your foot.
You are somehow still up.
I press a second time.
Is this lump enough.
A blob of gel drops to the ground.
I spread, then gather.
Two gels settle in layers inside me.
A wet patch presses into the ground.
I swell up little by little.
I am a size up from my kin.
Both cores lit up.
Sweetness hangs in the air.
I wobble twice and settle.

lines.zh: 两种颜色在我体内转起来。
lines.en: Two colours start turning inside me.
The fire makes my gel shrink.
I land as a flat pancake.
I thin out a little in water.
The blast blows me in two.
Something pierced through my gel.
This light makes both cores shiver.
Unfed, I shrink.
Lightning hit me, and my gel steams.
There is no ground here to spread on.
